title: Finite-primary coefficient devissage for the geometric affine line
statement:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, $\ell$ a prime invertible in $k$, and $B$ a finite abelian group killed by $\ell^a$ for some $a\geq1$. Let $B_T$ denote the constant abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] of a scheme $T$. Put $C=\mathbf A^1_k$ [def-sbc-affine-space]. Use ordinary derived sections and cohomology [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and the bounded-below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The canonical constants map is an isomorphism
$$B[0]\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma(C_{\mathrm{et}},B_C)$$
in $D^+(\mathrm{Ab})$. In particular the constants map $B\to H^0(C,B_C)$ is an isomorphism and $H^q(C,B_C)=0$ for every $q\ne0$, with zero cohomology in negative degrees by convention. The constants maps commute with homomorphisms of finite $\ell$-primary groups. The order of $B$ is a power of $\ell$. No freeness of $B$ over $\mathbf Z/\ell^a$ is required.

source.place: Coefficients and Degrees 0 and 1, affine-line part: agent refinement from cyclic prime coefficients to arbitrary finite primary groups by the cardinality induction retained in report.md.

proof.text: On the connected geometric affine line, the global-sections constants unit is invertible for every abelian coefficient group by [lem-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf-sections-connected]. Use Adjunction.unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app to transport the evaluation-at-terminal-object unit to the specific right adjoint Sheaf.Γ used in the statement.

source.place: Coefficients and Degrees 0 and 1; shorter finite abelian-group decomposition refinement by Q8.

proof.text: For each positive integer m invertible in k, choose a primitive root using [lem-sc-primitive-root]. Apply [lem-pur-kummer-root-line-computation] at false in every positive degree. The isomorphism [def-sc-mu-trivialization] transfers vanishing from roots of unity to the constant ZMod m sheaf. Mathlib AffineSpace.SpecIso and MvPolynomial.uniqueAlgEquiv identify the two affine-line presentations. Pullback along that scheme isomorphism preserves cohomology by [prop-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-topos], and the canonical upperStarConstantSheafIso identifies pulled-back constants with constants.

source.place: Coefficients and Degrees 0 and 1; shorter finite abelian-group decomposition refinement by Q8.

proof.text: Use Mathlib AddCommGroup.equiv_directSum_zmod_of_finite' and DirectSum.addEquivProd to write B as a finite product of ZMod(n_i), including the empty product when B=0. Apply the exponent hypothesis to the element supported at i with coordinate 1 to show n_i divides ell^a. Thus every n_i is invertible in k. Interpret the product as a finite categorical biproduct using AddCommGrpCat.biproductIsoPi. The preceding cyclic calculation and the identification of sheaf cohomology with right derived sections [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] imply that every positive right-derived sections functor vanishes on each constant cyclic summand. The composite of constants with each such derived functor is additive, hence preserves the finite biproduct, so it vanishes on B_C. This is acyclicity [def-sp-acyclic]. No freeness over ZMod(ell^a) is used.

source.place: Coefficients and Degrees 0 and 1; shorter finite abelian-group decomposition refinement by Q8.

proof.text: For the literal single complex B[0], exact constants produce a complex with degree-zero term B_C and zero terms elsewhere, all right-acyclic by Step 3. Apply [src-right-derived-functor-plus-acyclic-unit]. The termwise underived adjunction unit is invertible by Step 1, so the factorization of the derived adjunction unit in [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction] shows it is invertible on this single complex. Transport to DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor via its canonical quotient isomorphism. Unfold abelianDerivedConstants: it composes precisely this derived unit with canonical comparison isomorphisms, hence the specified map itself is invertible. Applying every homology functor identifies its target with B[0], whose cohomology is zero in every degree different from zero.

source.place: Coefficients and Degrees 0 and 1; shorter finite abelian-group decomposition refinement by Q8.

proof.text: The displayed coefficient square is exactly abelianDerivedConstants.naturality; no resolution lifts are needed because the map has already been defined as a natural transformation. Finally the exponent hypothesis gives IsPGroup ell (Multiplicative B) by Mathlib isPGroup_iff_pow_pow_eq_one. Mathlib IsPGroup.exists_card_eq and invariance of Nat.card under the type-tag equivalence give Nat.card B = ell^b, including b=0 for the zero group.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q82-ce8611d30 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read all seven steps in full, plus the unit sk-prop-a1-kummer and the main-20261015 proof paragraphs Coefficients / Clause (c) / Degrees 0 and 1. The statement is unchanged from live and side-live, where the item is still unsplit with no repair note, so the delivery is not superseded. The proof is a strong induction on |D| for groups killed by ℓ^a. Base case D=0 (S1). The ℓ-cyclic input (S2) uses lem-sc-primitive-root (k algebraically closed, ℓ invertible), def-sc-mu-trivialization with a primitive ζ, and lem-pur-kummer-root-line-computation with m=ℓ, b=false. That node gives H^{>0}=0 and an H^0 isomorphism sending 1 to the constant root; this equals H^0(θ_ζ)∘c, since a ZMod ℓ-linear map is fixed by the image of 1. S3 builds the order-ℓ subgroup by Bezout and a coset count; it is elementary. S4 makes the short exact sequence of constant sheaves exact by exact sheafification (03CO/00WJ) and applies the long exact sequence (015B); its hypotheses come from def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, and H^1(K)=0 comes from S2. S5 is an elementary chase. S6 shows the explicit map B[0]→Γ(C,I•) is a quasi-isomorphism, inverted in D^+(Ab). S7 proves naturality by the lift 013P (its α is a degreewise-mono quasi-isomorphism into a bounded-below injective complex), uniqueness up to homotopy 013S, and homotopy invariance under localization. Edge cases checked: B=0, Z/ℓ, Z/ℓ², nonfree (Z/ℓ)² over Z/ℓ², ℓ=2, and different exponents. There are no new nodes and no cycle. sk-prop-h1 nodes lie on the transitive unit route. The five pbc homological tool_uses are accepted as generic tools. There is no SGA source. Batch-5 flag: lem-pur-kummer-root-line-computation reaches def-pod-ring-scalar-extension only through curve cohomological dimension and Picard/Jacobian definitions.
